$comment: Letter styles (#350). breaks_after is a default: school schemes differ, and the teacher view may change it later. No degree targets for slant: no official source gives one. slant agrees with the face each style is drawn in, measured with vision/letter_geometry._slant on Google Fonts' files (docs/history/letter-style-guess-2026-11-04.md). shop_products lists the free sheets for that style; styles without their own sheets get none yet. Print has no font: print examples use the site's own type and are labelled print.

styles.label: Looped cursive
styles.$comment: The free sheets are drawn in Playwrite IN, the same looped model leaning right as Playwrite US Trad (vahinitech/EdTechBooks#19).

styles.label: Vertical cursive
styles.$comment: No Playwrite face draws US looped cursive upright; Playwrite AR is the upright looped face closest to it.

styles.label: Straight cursive (India)
styles.$comment: Looped rules written upright, as in many Indian cursive books; named apart from vertical because schools call it this.

styles.label: Joined with breaks
styles.$comment: England's joined handwriting and California's joined italic option. Break letters vary by scheme.

styles.label: Australian joined (Victoria)
styles.$comment: Victorian Modern Cursive. The other states' scripts (Playwrite AU NSW, QLD, SA, TAS) are entries to add the same way.

styles.label: Print
styles.$comment: The control: every letter separate. Germany's Grundschrift and Finland's print-only teaching count here.
